backend.auth: Keycloak JWKS-based BearerTokenVerifier (`internal/auth/keycloak_verifier.go`, PR #167 KC-PR-B) + enforceRoutePermission. JWKS cache (TTL 5분, [keycloak_verifier.go:37](../../backend-core/internal/auth/keycloak_verifier.go) `defaultJWKSTTL`) + resource_access.{client_id}.roles fallback. **stale-while-error fallback (PR #242 sprint -l, ADR-0020 sub-carve D)** — Keycloak unreachable 시 cachedUntil + MaxStaleDuration (default 24h, env `DEVHUB_OIDC_JWKS_MAX_STALE_DURATION`) 안 stale cache 사용. metric `devhub_jwks_stale_while_error_total{result}` + `devhub_jwks_stale_age_seconds` Histogram.
